question: Is there a native four-ring path when every ring may run any linear rule and every contact any law, at small sizes?

public_inputs.library: proofs/NATIVE-PATH-20261108-001A/NATIVE-PATH-20261108-001A-P001_paths_reduce_to_row_sequences/path_lib.py (sha256 52ce36a513db4fef263abc91d3b852430334e65fac0e146d6d37e8ddd0b060be): analyze; NATIVE-PATH-20261108-001B's run.py for the laws and the full-state-space check.
public_inputs.run: run.py in this folder, 16 worker processes; long-running, registered in docs/LONG_RUNNING.md as PATH-HYBRID-A1.
public_inputs.family: Every linear rule (0, 204, 240, 170, 60, 102, 90, 150) on each of the four rings: 4,096 tuples. Shapes 3/4/4/3 with both middle rings' contacts two apart, and 3/5/5/3 with them two or three apart: 5 shapes. Every law (10) at each of the three contacts: 1,000 triples. In all 20,480,000 paths.
public_inputs.exactness: Every verdict is exact by the row-sequence reduction.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the family after seeing results
primary_observable: The number of native paths, and of paths whose three contacts all persist; the rules and laws of the native ones.
cheapest_meaningful_control: The ten smallest native paths, if any, must agree on their full state spaces.
first_executable_signal: The control, or a count of zero.
decision_or_followup_rule: H1, frozen: some native path exists in the sweep. If it holds, verify and characterize the smallest. If not, the absence is recorded for this family.
stop_rule: Stop when every path of the family has its verdicts.
nonclaims: Exploratory and non-promotable: this family only.
feasibility_disclosure: Before freezing: NATIVE-PATH-20261108-001's results had been read (no native path in three restricted families). run.py --pilot timed 2,000 random paths of this family at 1.1 s and printed no verdicts; the full run is expected to take about 12 minutes.
